Hospital Service Area.definition: A description of the Health Service Area (HSA) in which the hospital is located.

Hospital County.definition: A description of the county in which the hospital is located.

Operating Certificate Number.definition: The facility Operating Certificate Number assigned by NYS Department of Health.

Facility Name.definition: The name of the facility where services were performed based on the Permanent Facility Identifier (PFI), as maintained by the NYSDOH Division of Health Facility Planning.

Age Group.definition: Age in years at time of admission/visit.

Zip Code - 3 digits.definition: The first three digits of the patient zip code.

Length of Stay.definition: The total number of patient days at an acute level and/or other than acute care level (excluding leave of absence days) (Discharge Date - Admission Date) + 1.

Type of Admission.definition: A description of the manner in which the patient was admitted to the health care facility: Elective, Emergency, Newborn, Not Available, Trauma, Urgent.

Patient Disposition.definition: The patients destination or status upon discharge.

CCSR Procedure Code.definition: AHRQ Clinical Classification Software Refined (CCSR) ICD-10 Procedure Category Code.

APR DRG Code.definition: The All Patients Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) Classification Code.

APR MDC Code.definition: All Patient Refined Major Diagnostic Category (APR MDC) Code.

APR MDC Description.definition: All Patient Refined Major Diagnostic Category (APR MDC) Description.

APR Risk of Mortality.definition: All Patient Refined Risk of Mortality (APR ROM) Description: Undetermined (0), Minor (1), Moderate (2), Major (3), Extreme (4).

APR Medical Surgical Description.definition: The APR-DRG specific classification of Medical, Surgical or Not Applicable.

Birth Weight.definition: The neonate birth weight in grams; rounded to nearest 100 g.

Emergency Department Indicator.definition: The Emergency Department Indicator is set based on the submitted revenue codes. If the record contained an Emergency Department revenue code of 045X, the indicator is set to Y, otherwise it will be N.

Total Costs.definition: Total estimated cost for the discharge.
